name: transporters
label: Transporters
description: Membrane transporters a drug is a substrate, inhibitor or inducer of. New in 1.5: P-gp effects are not metabolism and were previously unrecordable.

terms.label: P-glycoprotein (MDR1/ABCB1)
terms.note: Efflux pump at the gut wall and blood-brain barrier. Saturable, which is why a drug kept out of the CNS at label doses is not kept out at ten times the label dose.
